create_PPO_from_config: create a PPO updater instance from an actor_critic policy and a config object using from_config
update_PPO_policy: update the PPO policy by calling update with RolloutStorage to perform PPO training epochs
get_PPO_advantages: get normalized advantage estimates from rollout storage returns and value predictions
evaluate_PPO_actions: evaluate actions through the actor_critic policy to get values, log probs, and entropy
resume_PPO_training: resume PPO training by saving and loading the optimizer state via get_resume_state and load_state_dict
